proposal.description: Supervisor's S_RUN overcurrent exit is wired to the soft-start window trip window_trip_SS, so a RUN window trip never sends the FSM from S_RUN to S_HICCUP
proposal.reason: fault_arbiter only raises window_trip_SS in S_SS. With this fault, sustained overcurrent on CP_trig in S_RUN leaves En high and the converter in S_RUN with no hiccup, no strike and no latch_out, where the real design drops En and starts a hiccup.

proposal.description: Supervisor leaves soft start only when the ramp is done and the output comparator also reports the rail in window, as if 'soft start finished' meant 'output is up'
proposal.reason: If PGOOD_comp is low when soft_start raises SS_done, the FSM stays in S_SS instead of moving to S_RUN. PGOOD and switch_supply never assert, and the RUN overcurrent window is never armed, until the comparator goes high.

proposal.description: fault_cause's capture gate takes the qualified PGOOD as 'running' instead of run_active, so a fault in S_RUN before PGOOD has qualified, or during a rail dip, is not logged
proposal.reason: Say OTP, UVLO or a latch trip shuts the converter down from S_RUN within PGOOD_DELAY_CYCLES of entering it, or while PGOOD_comp is low. The fault-cause register (0x1D) and fault_time then stay empty when the host reads them, where the real design records the cause.

proposal.description: reg_file's live TIME registers are fed fault_cause's episode-start snapshot fault_time instead of the free-running timestamp_ms
proposal.reason: A host read of TIME_0..TIME_2 (0x18-0x1A) returns zero when no fault is logged, or the frozen episode start time after one, instead of a millisecond count that keeps advancing.

proposal.description: fault_cause infers OVP from the synchronised but undebounced SCR read-back instead of the debounced copy the supervisor and LEDs act on
proposal.reason: While the converter is in S_SS or S_RUN, a latch_stat pulse shorter than the 1 ms debounce sets the OVP bit and fault_time in the fault-cause register. The supervisor ignores the same pulse and does not shut down.

proposal.description: OTP debouncer is given the enable's fail-safe-low reset value, so over-temperature reads clear out of reset while its synchroniser resets high
proposal.reason: After reset with OTP_trig low, Red_LED2 and the OTP status bit read low at once, where the real design holds them high for the 200 us release time. If OTP_trig is high at reset, the hot condition is not reported for the first 1 ms.
